papers.title: From hammers to toolkits: A methodological framework for applying design science to orchestrating collaborative innovation processes
papers.abstract: Collaborative innovation is crucial in addressing complex challenges such as sustainability-oriented and technological transformation. While previous research has explored the mechanisms and outcomes of collaborative innovation, scholars and practitioners still lack clear, actionable guidance on how to design and facilitate effective collaborative innovation processes. This paper addresses this gap by developing a methodological framework that applies design science principles to orchestrate collaborative innovation processes. We conceptualize a shift from isolated tools ('hammers') to integrated, context-sensitive toolkits that can be combined and sequenced depending on the innovation challenge at hand. The framework offers both theoretical contributions to design science research and practical implications for innovation practitioners seeking to facilitate complex, multi-actor innovation processes.
papers.summary_ja: 協調的イノベーションプロセスをオーケストレートするためにデザインサイエンスを適用する方法論的フレームワークを提示し、孤立したツール（ハンマー）から状況適応型ツールキットへの移行を論じた実践指向の論文。複数アクターが関与する複雑なイノベーションプロセスのファシリテーターに向けた理論的・実践的示唆を提供する。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in strategic foresight: Evidence from a longitudinal case at Siemens Professional Education
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), and particularly generative AI, is increasingly discussed as a transformative force in strategic foresight. Yet empirical evidence on how AI is integrated into organizational foresight practices, and with what epistemic and governance implications, remains limited. This study examines a longitudinal case at Siemens Professional Education, tracing how AI tools were progressively integrated into foresight activities including environmental scanning, trend analysis, and scenario development. We find that while AI accelerates data processing and pattern recognition in early foresight stages, human judgment remains central in sensemaking and normative interpretation. AI integration also introduces new governance challenges around validation of AI-generated insights and epistemic shifts toward probabilistic futures thinking.
papers.summary_ja: シーメンスにおける生成AIの戦略的フォーサイト実務への縦断的統合事例を分析し、AIがシナリオ開発を加速する一方で人間の意味形成が不可欠であること、そして新たなガバナンス課題（AI生成インサイトの検証体制）が生じることを実証した研究。

papers.title: Five business problems platform thinking helps legacy firms solve
papers.abstract: Legacy firms struggle to adapt in a business environment increasingly shaped by platform-based models. While research has emphasized how digital-native companies harness network effects and ecosystems, less is known about how incumbents apply platform thinking to address their own challenges. We analyzed how legacy firms have applied platform thinking to solve five recurring business problems: (1) deepening customer relationships beyond transactions, (2) capturing external innovation, (3) monetizing underutilized assets, (4) expanding partnerships, and (5) entering new markets. Each problem is paired with a platform-based solution and illustrative cases from incumbent industries. Our framework offers managers a practical entry point into platform strategy without requiring full platform transformation.
papers.summary_ja: デジタルネイティブではないレガシー大企業がプラットフォーム思考を活用して解決できる5つの典型的ビジネス問題（顧客関係深化・外部イノベーション取込み・遊休資産収益化・パートナーシップ拡張・新市場開拓）を体系的フレームワークとして提示した実践的論文。

papers.title: Building anticipatory capacity for transformative resilience: Lessons from UK and EU applying strategic foresight in grand societal challenge-oriented regional policy
papers.abstract: Grand Societal Challenges (GSCs) require regional policymakers to develop new forms of anticipatory capacity. This is defined as the ability to navigate uncertainty, align diverse stakeholders and direct development towards long-term societal goals. This study argues that, when implemented within a GSC-oriented regional policy context, strategic foresight practices strengthen anticipatory capacity and thereby contribute to transformative resilience. Drawing on comparative case analysis of UK and EU policy regions, we identify three mechanisms through which foresight builds anticipatory capacity: participatory horizon scanning, normative scenario development, and adaptive policy roadmapping.
papers.summary_ja: 英国・EUの地域政策事例を比較分析し、グランドチャレンジに対応する「先見的能力（anticipatory capacity）」をどう構築するかを戦略的フォーサイトの文脈で論じ、変革的レジリエンスへの示唆を導出した研究。

papers.title: Digital transformation and business model innovation in legal services: The case of LegalTech
papers.abstract: This article examines how digital transformation drives business model innovation within professional service firms, using legal services as an illustrative case. LegalTech, positioned at the intersection of law and digital technologies, represents a sector-specific expression of digital transformation in knowledge-intensive services. Drawing on multiple case studies of LegalTech firms, we develop a process model that captures how digitalization enables incremental and radical BMI across three dimensions: value creation, value delivery, and value capture. The findings show that digital transformation does not lead uniformly to BMI but is mediated by institutional pressures, client demands, and organizational ambidexterity.
papers.summary_ja: リーガルテック事例を通じてプロフェッショナルサービス業のデジタル変革がビジネスモデル革新（BMI）を駆動するプロセスモデルを提示し、デジタル化とBMIの関係が組織両利き経営・制度的圧力・顧客需要によって媒介されることを示した研究。

papers.title: How narratives construct wickedness in mission-oriented innovation policy problems
papers.abstract: Mission-oriented innovation policies are promoted as a means of tackling wicked societal problems that are contested, complex and uncertain, but it is unclear how policy designs should account for such wickedness. This study illustrates how contestation, complexity and uncertainty can be constructed through narratives in policy processes, and how this shapes mission design. We contribute a narrative analysis framework for mission-oriented innovation policy, showing that the way wickedness is narrated determines which missions get prioritized and how they are designed.
papers.summary_ja: ミッション指向イノベーション政策において「邪悪な問題」がどのようにナラティブを通じて構築・強化されるかを分析し、ナラティブの違いがミッションの優先順位付けと設計に影響することを示したフレームワーク論文。

papers.title: Liminal Ambidexterity: Organizing Between Executional Simplicity and Adaptive Complexity in Transitional Environments
papers.authors: Gabija Skučaitė and Mehmet Recai Uygur
papers.abstract: This conceptual paper develops the notion of liminal ambidexterity to explain how organizations remain effective when their established routines continue to support performance but cease to orient them toward future advantage. Using concepts such as ambidexterity, liminality, dynamic capabilities, resilience, and management control, the paper argues that transitional environments require firms to maintain executional simplicity in the operational core while creating sufficient adaptive complexity at the edge. The framework recognizes three indexed domains: the Simplicity Discipline Index (SDI), the Complexity Capability Index (CCI), and the Complexity Load Index (CLI). In addition, translational governance is introduced as a mechanism that converts ambiguous signals into a limited set of executable commitments. The paper contributes a quadrant model, a capability-load fit logic, a refined definition of translational governance, illustrative empirical anchors, and a measurement architecture for future empirical testing.
papers.summary_ja: 移行期にある組織で既存ルーティンが業績を支えつつも将来優位性への方向づけを失う状態を「閾域的両利き（Liminal Ambidexterity）」として概念化した理論論文。中核業務の実行的シンプルさと周縁の適応的複雑さを両立させる枠組みとして、SDI（シンプルさ規律指標）・CCI（複雑性ケイパビリティ指標）・CLI（複雑性負荷指標）の3指標と、曖昧なシグナルを限定された実行可能なコミットメントへ変換する「翻訳的ガバナンス」を提唱する。実証検証は今後の課題。
papers.analysis_unit: 概念論文（実証データなし、測定枠組みの提案まで）

papers.title: Behavioral integration and organizational dynamic capabilities: The mediating role of job demands
papers.abstract: The extant research on organizational dynamic capabilities has identified various antecedents of these capabilities at the environmental, organizational, and managerial levels. However, drivers of dynamic capabilities at the top-management-team (TMT) level have received less attention. This study examines the relationship between TMT behavioral integration and organizational dynamic capabilities, with job demands as a mediating variable. Drawing on survey data from 237 TMT members across 89 firms, we find that behavioral integration positively predicts dynamic capabilities, mediated by cognitive and emotional job demands on TMT members.
papers.summary_ja: 237名のTMTメンバー調査に基づき、トップマネジメントチームの行動統合が動的ケイパビリティに与える正の影響を実証し、「職務要求（認知的・感情的）」がその媒介変数として機能することを明らかにした定量研究。

papers.title: ADT: a digital card-based toolkit for AI-augmented design thinking
papers.abstract: This paper presents ADT, a digital card-based toolkit designed to integrate AI into the Design Thinking process. A survey of 204 designers examined AI literacy, usage patterns, and adoption barriers. Results indicated uneven familiarity, with higher use in Prototyping and Testing stages. Key challenges included prompting, trust, ethics, and training gaps. ADT, thus, structures four professional roles across five design-thinking stages, providing reusable prompts, recommended AI tools, exemplar outputs, and ethical reminders to promote informed and responsible human-AI collaboration.
papers.summary_ja: デザイナー204名への調査でAIリテラシー・利用実態・採用障壁を把握し（プロトタイプ・テスト段階で利用が多く、障壁はプロンプト設計・信頼・倫理・研修不足）、その知見をもとにデザイン思考の5段階×4つの職能ロールにAI活用を割り付けるデジタルカードツールキット「ADT」を開発。61名による評価で概念的明瞭性を含む4次元とも良好な結果を得た。
papers.analysis_unit: デザイナー204名の調査＋ツールキット開発＋61名による評価

papers.title: Scaling innovation through public procurement: Market acceleration, building, and transformation
papers.abstract: Public procurement of innovation (PPI) is increasingly recognised as a powerful demand-side instrument for generating solutions to complex societal challenges. Yet realising this transformative potential requires innovations to scale beyond isolated implementation contexts. We contribute to the literature by bridging innovation scaling and market shaping perspectives to develop a novel conceptual framework. The framework distinguishes three modes of PPI-driven scaling: market acceleration (scaling within existing market structures), market building (creating new market structures), and market transformation (reshaping systemic conditions). Each mode has distinct implications for public buyers, innovators, and policy designers.
papers.summary_ja: 公共調達によるイノベーションスケーリングを「市場加速・市場形成・市場変革」の3モードで理論化し、公共調達機関・イノベーター・政策立案者それぞれへの含意を示した新概念フレームワーク論文。
